supporting_quotes.exact: In computer science, a queue is an abstract data type that serves as an ordered collection of entities.
By convention, the end of the queue where elements are added is called the back, tail, or rear of the queue. The end of the queue where elements are removed is called the head or front of the queue.

observations.subject: queue
observations.object: abstract data type, ordered collection of entities

observations.subject: queue
observations.object: addition end = back/tail/rear; removal end = head/front

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,103)（In computer science, a queue is an abstract data type that serves as an ordered collection of entities.）直接支持 claim 前句（队列=计算机科学中作为实体有序集合的抽象数据类型）；引文 [0,198) 明示添加端称 back/tail/rear、移除端称 head/front 的约定，完整支持 claim 后句。两段引文语义一致、无冲突。说明：本审计上下文仅含引文摘录而未含源文全文，故 rationale_offsets 以所提供引文整体为参照（start=0，end=引文 Unicode code point 数）。

supporting_quotes.exact: Enqueue, which adds one element to the rear of the queue
Dequeue, which removes one element from the front of the queue.
Other operations may also be allowed, often including a peek or front operation that returns the value of the next element to be dequeued without dequeuing it.

observations.subject: enqueue
observations.object: one element to the rear of the queue

observations.subject: dequeue
observations.object: one element from the front of the queue

observations.subject: peek/front operation
observations.object: value of next element to be dequeued, without dequeuing it

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,56)（Enqueue, which adds one element to the rear of the queue）与 [0,63)（Dequeue, which removes one element from the front of the queue.）分别对应 claim 的 enqueue/dequeue 两个主要操作；引文 [0,159)（Other operations may also be allowed, often including a peek or front operation...）对应 peek/front 操作及返回下一出队元素而不出队的语义。三段引文与 claim 分句一一对应、一致且无冲突。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: make it a first-in-first-out (FIFO) data structure as the first element added to the queue is the first one removed.
This is equivalent to the requirement that once a new element is added, all elements that were added before have to be removed before the new element can be removed.

observations.subject: queue
observations.object: FIFO data structure: first element added is first one removed

observations.subject: FIFO ordering
observations.object: all prior elements removed before a new element can be removed

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,116) 明示队列为先进先出（FIFO）数据结构（the first element added to the queue is the first one removed），支持 claim 前半；引文 [0,165)（This is equivalent to the requirement that...）提供等价表述：新元素加入后必须先移除所有先于它的元素，完整支持 claim 后半。两段引文一致，构成定义+等价条件的互补证据，无冲突。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: A queue is an example of a linear data structure, or more abstractly a sequential collection.

observations.subject: queue
observations.object: example of linear data structure / sequential collection

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,93) 逐字对应该 claim（A queue is an example of a linear data structure, or more abstractly a sequential collection.），线性数据结构与顺序集合表述与 claim 完全一致，支持充分。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: A queue may be implemented as circular buffers and linked lists, or by using both the stack pointer and the base pointer.

observations.subject: queue
observations.object: circular buffers and linked lists (or stack pointer + base pointer)

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,121) 明示队列可能实现为 circular buffers 和 linked lists（另提及 stack/base pointer 组合），包含并支持 claim 主张的两种实现；claim 未作排他性断言，与引文无冲突。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: A bounded queue is a queue limited to a fixed number of items.

observations.subject: bounded queue
observations.object: queue limited to a fixed number of items

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,62) 与 claim 逐字对应（A bounded queue is a queue limited to a fixed number of items.，即限制为固定数量条目），完全支持。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: There are several efficient implementations of FIFO queues. An efficient implementation is one that can perform the operations—en-queuing and de-queuing—in O(1) time.

observations.subject: efficient FIFO queue implementation
observations.object: O(1) time for en-queuing and de-queuing

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,163) 明示存在多种高效 FIFO 队列实现（There are several efficient implementations of FIFO queues），并定义高效为 en-queuing 与 de-queuing 均在 O(1) 时间完成（can perform the operations—en-queuing and de-queuing—in O(1) time），与 claim 完全一致。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: A doubly linked list has O(1) insertion and deletion at both ends, so it is a natural choice for queues.

observations.subject: doubly linked list
observations.object: O(1) insertion and deletion at both ends

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,104) 明示双向链表两端插入与删除均为 O(1)（O(1) insertion and deletion at both ends），因此是队列的 natural choice，与 claim 逐句对应、完全支持。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: A regular singly linked list only has efficient insertion and deletion at one end. However, a small modification—keeping a pointer to the last node in addition to the first one—will enable it to implement an efficient queue.

observations.subject: regular singly linked list
observations.object: efficient queue via extra pointer to last node

qualifiers.modification: keeping a pointer to the last node in addition to the first one

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,222) 前半（only has efficient insertion and deletion at one end）支持 claim 第一句常规单链表仅一端高效插入删除；后半（a small modification—keeping a pointer to the last node in addition to the first one—will enable it to implement an efficient queue）支持 claim 第二句保存指向最后节点指针即可实现高效队列。两个分句均获支持，无冲突。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: A deque implemented using a modified dynamic array

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,50)（A deque implemented using a modified dynamic array）虽为名词短语，但语义明确主张 deque 可以用改造后的动态数组实现，支持 claim 的断言。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: FIFO is an abbreviation for first in, first out. It is a method for handling data structures where the first element is processed first and the newest element is processed last.
Certain data structures like Queue and other variants of Queue uses FIFO approach for processing data.

observations.subject: FIFO
observations.object: method where first element processed first and newest element processed last

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,177) 给出 FIFO 全称（first in, first out）与方法定义（the first element is processed first and the newest element is processed last），支持 claim 前半；引文 [0,102) 明示 Queue 及其变体使用 FIFO 方式处理数据（Queue and other variants of Queue uses FIFO approach for processing data），支持 claim 后半。两段引文一致、无冲突。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。

supporting_quotes.exact: Disk controllers can use the FIFO as a disk scheduling algorithm to determine the order in which to service disk I/O requests.
Communication network bridges, switches and routers used in computer networks use FIFOs to hold data packets en route to their next destination.

observations.subject: disk controllers
observations.object: FIFO as disk scheduling algorithm for disk I/O request service order

observations.subject: network bridges/switches/routers
observations.object: FIFOs to hold data packets en route to their next destination

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,126) 明示磁盘控制器可用 FIFO 作为磁盘调度算法决定磁盘 I/O 请求的服务顺序，支持 claim 第一个分句；引文 [0,144) 明示通信网络中的网桥、交换机与路由器用 FIFO 暂存去往下一目的地的数据包，支持 claim 第二个分句。两个分句分别获独立引文支持，一致且无冲突。offset 以所提供引文整体为参照。
